title: My Well Has Run Dry
description: Vanilla (and Bedrock) friendly Fabric mod for the server adding unique and interesting new content
body:
# My Well Has Run Dry

"My Well Has Run Dry" (MWHRD) is a **Fabric modification** for *Minecraft: Java Edition*.
The mod is a quality-of-life and content expansion mod that adds new features and mechanics to the game.

Available for **1.21.5** at:
- [GitHub: KingRainbow44/mhwrd](https://github.com/KingRainbow44/MyWellHasRunDry)

## Features

A list of all the features can be found in the [Features](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features) page,
but a quick overview (as of 2.0) can be found below:

- [Trial Chambers have been significantly overhauled](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#trial-chambers)
- [Shift-click to open Ender Chests and Shulker Boxes](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#quick-open)
- [New recipes have been added for existing items](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/recipes#minecraft)
- [Balancing changes have been made](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#balancing)
- [An optional Hardcore Mode has been added](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#hardcore-mode)
- [Bedrock players have a few quality of life changes](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#bedrock-qol)
- [Brewing stands instantly brew potions](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#instant-brewing)
- [Beacons have an optional upgrade](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#beacons)
- [New structures have been added](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#new-structures)
- [New dimensions have been added](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/features#new-dimensions)

For all features, I suggest looking at the [Changelog](https://docs.seikimo.moe/mwhrd/changelog) for more brief information!
